Sam (Recruiter): Quick sync — candidate Jordan K. for Backend SWE (L3). Need a 4-person panel + debrief. Who's available next Tue/Wed mornings PT?
Alex R.: Tue morning works for me (anytime 8:30–11 PT).
Tess: Wed is better for me, but I can shift on Tue if needed. Prefer 9:00–10:30 PT.
Ravi: I have sprint planning Tues 9:30, so Tue earlier or Wed midday.
Liz H.: I can do Tue 10–11 PT or Wed 9–11 PT.
Sam (Recruiter): Sounds like Tue 9:00 PT is a possible sweet spot (Alex + Liz overlap, Tess could move). Can everyone hold 9–10 PT as tentative? I’ll book provisional blocks.
Tess: Holding 9–10 PT tentatively.
Ravi: Ok for 9–10 PT if I can leave by 10:15 for planning.
Alex R.::+1: lock it if Sam can send calendar invite with buffer.
People Ops Bot: Provisional event created: "Jordan K. — Backend SWE (panel)" Tue 2025-03-25 09:00 PT — 60m. Invite link: https://cal.redwood.example/evt/abc123 (auto-reminder 24h).
Sam (Recruiter): Thanks bot. Quick rubric question: do we use Eng Rubric v2 for this level? Also want to confirm weighting — system design vs coding exercise vs collaboration.
Liz H.: Yes, use Eng Rubric v2 (link: https://docs.redwood/example/rubrics/eng-v2). For L3, emphasize system design ~40%, coding/algorithms ~35%, collaboration/cultural fit ~25%. Use 1–5 scale per section and add 2–3 sentence rationale.
Alex R.: FWIW, let's not penalize for missing proprietary product knowledge — focus on design trade-offs and clarity.
Tess: Quick ask — where do we record debrief notes? Greenhouse or shared doc?
Sam (Recruiter): Please add scores in Greenhouse and paste a 1-paragraph summary to the panel debrief doc: https://docs.redwood/example/hiring/debriefs/jordan-k. That keeps structured data + human summary.
Ravi: On deconfliction — I may join remotely for last 20m if planning runs late. If I'm not there, I'll add short notes in GH within 2 hours.
Liz H.: Reminder: use the "evidence-first" comments — cite specific answers or code lines. If someone gives a weak answer, note follow-up questions you would have asked.
Alex R.: Also can we standardize the start: 5m intro (candidate + role), 25m design, 20m coding, 10m Q&A. That helps scoring consistency.
Sam (Recruiter): Perfect — I'll include that agenda in the invite. Final ask: can everyone please skim the rubric before the interview. Ping me if you need a 10-min rubric walkthrough.
Tess: Can do. If anyone wants a quick 1:1 rubric chat, ping me.
People Ops Bot: Reminder scheduled: "Panel debrief reminder" 30m after event end — will ping this thread and @Sam (Recruiter).
Sam (Recruiter): Great, thanks all. I’ll send the confirmed invite and GH link. If anything changes, update the calendar or drop a note here. :thumbsup:
Alex R.: Thanks — see you Tue 9 PT.
Tess: Thanks!
Ravi: Thanks everyone.
